notes.subject: plate
notes.text: The only African country with fully blue plates; newer Generation 4 plates look European, white with a blue strip on the left.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 4 shows a silver or white truck cab in many road- and region-specific variants; near the capital a black pickup also appears.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 3 shows a roof rack and the right side mirror, a combination unique here, plus rifts in the sky.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Traffic drives on the right, unlike Kenya and Uganda.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Bollards, poles, signs and road lines follow the style of the former colonial power in Europe.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: The official and most common written language is the European one, unlike other sub-Saharan coverage which is mostly English.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: White kilometre markers with a red top show the road number and distances to nearby towns; the farthest town is usually the biggest.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Town entry signs are white with a thick pink outline and the name in bold black letters.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Simple black streetlamps topped with a solar panel are common.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Yellow-orange taxis with black fenders are a common sight.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Flat, arid savannah-desert with sparse, short trees and faded leaves covers most of the country.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: South of the enclave country in the middle it is greener and lusher, with palms nearer the coast.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The central region has the most rural coverage: sandy roads with sparse trees.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Gently rolling vegetated sand dunes run along the northwestern coast.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Greener, larger hills appear in the far southeast; drier slight hills near Bakel in the east.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Irrigated rice fields appear between Saint-Louis and Richard Toll in the north.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A silver Generation 4 car with a long antenna at front left is seen on many roads, but none past the eastern edge of the central region.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The great mosque in Touba has five tall minarets visible from afar.
